stories.title: “Children will be pushed into exile”: Saltney campaigners on Catholic super-school plan
stories.summary: Opponents of plans to close four Catholic schools in Flintshire to create a 3-18 super-school say it undermines the new Welsh Government’s commitment to strengthen Welsh culture. stories.title: Flintshire leader Dave Hughes eyes re-election at last AGM before polls
stories.summary: Councillor Dave Hughes will ask Flintshire County Council to back him as leader for another year on Tuesday, at the chamber’s last annual meeting before next May’s elections. stories.title: BAFTA-winner Richard Elfyn leads cast of new Atlantis play at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: A new play about a Welsh coastal community facing rising seas will run at Theatr Clwyd in Mold from 6 June to 4 July. stories.title: Foster Care Fortnight launches in Flintshire as council seeks more local carers
stories.summary: Foster Care Fortnight launches in Flintshire on Monday, with Flintshire County Council and Foster Wales urging more local families to consider becoming foster carers.
